title: Empowering Retail: Secure Identity Validation Solutions for the Modern Era
lead: Stop identity fraud at the point of sale while keeping checkout frictionless for customers.
seoDescription: Protect your business and improve customer experience with Scytáles retail identity validation solutions.

sections.heading: The challenges
points: Fraudsters use increasingly advanced tactics to make illegal purchases.
Retailers are left exposed and unprepared.
Digital identity verification is now essential to retail defences.
Fraudsters have to be spotted and stopped in their tracks.
Checks must run fast enough to stay invisible.
Customers still expect a frictionless purchase.

sections.heading: Our approach
sections.lead: Digital identity verification at the point of purchase — an automated check that spots and stops fraud without adding a step the customer can feel. It runs on the devices retailers already have, from e-gates and workstation terminals to standard NFC and Bluetooth phones and tablets.

sections.heading: Why choose Scytáles
rail: The Scytáles ISO mValidator app lets relying parties inspect a mobile ID or mobile driving licence.
Instant validation and authentication against the identity provider.
An automated process, with no manual inspection step.
Runs on sophisticated e-gates and workstation terminals.
Runs equally on standard NFC and Bluetooth smartphones and tablets.

demoText: See how our tailored solutions meet your needs with a personalized product demonstration.
